description: Attaches or detaches ONE tag across a selection of tracked keywords (up to 500 keyword IDs per call). One tag per call — applying three tags takes three calls. FREE: database only. No SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent. The tag is the project's EXISTING saved-keyword vocabulary, shared with the saved-keyword list. Pass `tagId` for a tag that already exists (find it with list_rank_keyword_tags), or `tagName` to match on the normalised name. On `action: "add"` an unknown `tagName` CREATES that tag for the whole project, so check the vocabulary first rather than coining near-duplicates; on `action: "remove"` an unknown tag is NOT_FOUND, because there is nothing to detach. DO NOT REPORT `changed` AS A COUNT OF NEW LINKS ON AN ADD. `action: "add"` returns `changed: null` because the insert is idempotent and how many links were actually new is not knowable without a second read — `null` means "not measured". It is not zero, and it is NOT the number of keyword IDs submitted. `action: "remove"` returns a real `changed` count. When asked how many keywords were touched, report `keywordCount`: the tracked keywords the action was applied to, after de-duplication. Both actions return `keywordCount: 0` with `changed: 0` when none of the submitted IDs belong to this tracker — a no-op, not a tagging worth reporting as done.

action.description: 'add' attaches the tag, creating it from `tagName` when it does not exist yet; 'remove' detaches it.

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

tagId.description: Existing tag ID from list_rank_keyword_tags. Pass this OR `tagName`, never both.

tagName.description: Tag name, matched on its normalised form — 'Branded', 'branded' and ' branded ' are one tag. Created on 'add' when it does not exist; NOT_FOUND on 'remove'. Pass this OR `tagId`, never both.

trackingKeywordIds.description: Tracking-keyword IDs to tag or untag (1–500 per call). These are the rank tracker's own keyword-row IDs — not saved-keyword IDs, and not keyword text. Duplicates are collapsed, and IDs belonging to another tracker are ignored rather than errored.

name: update_rank_keyword_tag
